scope: Local transient overhead chat in Adventure. Existing private/friend chats, battle rules and closed Rift/Colosseum modes retained.

behavior.keyboard: Enter/Numpad Enter in the available world opens the composer, Enter sends once, Escape closes; native form/control focus and IME composition respected. Walking focuses the world canvas. Typing suspends movement, NPC actions and controller navigation.
behavior.mobile: A small speech button on the map opens the same composer without enlarging the header. The movement dock is hidden only during composition, restoring map space while the keyboard is open.
behavior.visibility: One latest bubble per player, seven seconds after receipt, following the same interpolated actor/camera coordinates. Bubbles drawn over foreground/weather/night tint, in the viewer theme. Nearby text boxes avoid overlap; very crowded tiny viewports may defer an unplaceable bubble until space becomes free.
behavior.network: Authenticated world:chat handler uses authoritative sender identity/map. Broadcast world:speech to that Adventure map room only, including the sender. Max 160 Unicode code points server-side and 160 UTF-16 units in the native input; 2-second per-connection cooldown. Control/bidi characters normalized; text is canvas/Vue text, never HTML.
behavior.ephemeral: No server history/DB write. No catch-up on reload. Renderer discards expired, departed, other-map and fighting actors; local speech/composer clear on map/disconnect/unmount. Existing private chats are separate.
behavior.performance: Lazy renderer, one cached high-resolution bitmap per speaking player; no new canvas allocation on ordinary movement frames. Cache invalidation only for text/palette/scale/width changes, bounded to 32 actors. No independent animation loop, only one bounded live-announcement timer.

unit.command: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/world-chat.test.js tests/network-delivery.test.js tests/world-movement.test.js tests/account-connection.test.js tests/team-drag-client.test.js
unit.coverage: Text/Unicode/limits/control characters, authoritative identity/rooms, cooldown/unavailable states, wrapping without truncation, bitmap allocation reuse, palette/scale changes, expiry/replacement/departure/memory bound, non-overlapping boxes; existing account/network/movement/drag regressions.

validation.integration: Two real browser sessions on one map, third authenticated socket on another map; actual server and explorakit_test. Real keyboard open/send/cancel, empty and IME guards, gamepad event consumption, no movement/action while typing, simultaneous speech, sender/map forgery rejected by authority, draft preserved after rate rejection, expiry, reload without history, movement resumes, disconnect cleanup. Team and inventory SQL snapshots identical. Test users removed.
